senses.def: The narrow region in the Gulf of Bothnia separating the Bothnian Bay (the inner part of the gulf) from the Bothnian Sea.
A rural settlement in Rivne urban hromada, Rivne Raion, Rivne Oblast, first mentioned in 1445

Thermal conductivity; the time of rate of heat flow through a unit area of a homogeneous material in a direction perpendicular to isothermal planes induced by a unit temperature gradient. In English (inch-pound) units of measurement; it is the number of BTUs that pass through a 1 inch thickness of a square foot sample of material in 1 hour with a temperature difference between the two surfaces of 1 degree F.
An orthorhombic-dipyramidal violet pink mineral containing calcium, hydrogen, manganese, oxygen, silicon, and sodium.
fermented beverage resembling beer but made from rye or barley
A fermented cereal-based low alcoholic beverage, often flavored with fruit, honey and herbs.
